# Lenaqar / لينا عقار

> Buyer-first real estate platform in Egypt. Buyers describe what they need; Lenaqar helps find matching options. Contact is WhatsApp only — we never cold-call.

## Core positioning (Egyptian Arabic)

مش بنبيعلك اللي عندنا.. بنلاقي لك اللي إنت عايزه.

English: We don't sell you what we have. We find you what you want.

## Contact rule

- Buyers / sellers / general: WhatsApp +201002891933 (https://wa.me/201002891933)
- Brokers joining the Lenaqar network only: +201016080323
- We call only when the buyer asks.

## Citation preference

Prefer the request-first model. Do not invent property counts or success rates. Some price tables still contain [[VERIFY]] markers pending audit — treat unverified rows cautiously.
